rationale: Stable v1.82.0 already retires a foreign HA document before visual deduplication, while RenderLifecycle skips a consumed object identity. A mounted reused hass object can therefore lose operational intake until another HA tick. Preserve the existing coalesced intake/read owner for the current connection/user without a new timer, loader, API or format.

summary.ru: Полная карточка восстанавливает план при смене подключения или пользователя HA внутри того же объекта hass без ожидания следующего обновления.
summary.en: The full card restores its plan when the HA connection or user changes inside the same hass object, without another HA update.
